# Design

## Target flows

### forge-svc-01.settle-refund: A refund is settled (forge-svc-01, modify)

A settled refund is published.

- add after step 2 (publish): The settled refund is published to forge.refunds.issued → forge-svc-03 forge.refunds.issued (new); fields batokbaKeltokren

### New flow forge-svc-03.on-refund-issued: Hear of an issued refund (forge-svc-03, new)

It keeps a copy of each refund.

- add after step 0 (entry): The issued refund is read from forge.refunds.issued; fields batokbaKeltokren

## Rollout and rollback

The change writes and alters no table, so it has nothing to migrate back: roll back by redeploying the previous version of each repo, in the reverse of the deploy order. Atticus wrote this from the target flows; a person confirms it in the architecture PR.
